create_entity_agent_with_logging: create an EntityAgentWithLogging instance with an act component and optional context components and measurements
get_last_log: get the latest log datum from all available measurement channels as a dictionary
get_all_logs: retrieve all measurement channels and their full log history from the agent
set_capture_key_for_thread: register a per-thread capture key mapping thread ID to entity name for async log isolation
clear_capture_key_for_thread: remove the per-thread capture key for a given thread ID when the entity loop exits
